description: The image displays three pie charts illustrating human pairwise comparison results across three datasets: “Truthful Review,” “Funny Reddit,” and “Unhealthy Comments,” each comparing preferences for hypotheses categorized as “W/o Demos” (gray), “Hard to Tell” (blue), and “W/ Demos” (teal). Each chart is divided into three slices, with the “W/o Demos” category consistently the largest, followed by “W/ Demos,” and then “Hard to Tell.” For “Truthful Review,” the proportions are 43.0% (gray), 22.9% (blue), and 34.1% (teal). For “Funny Reddit,” the proportions are 41.5% (gray), 21.5% (blue), and 37.1% (teal). For “Unhealthy Comments,” the proportions are 37.8% (gray), 27.4% (blue), and 34.8% (teal). Each slice is labeled with its percentage and color-coded according to the legend provided at the top, which maps gray to “W/o Demos,” blue to “Hard to Tell,” and teal to “W/ Demos.” The slices are arranged in a clockwise order that generally reflects their size, with the largest segment appearing first.
